integrity.evidence: Complete symbolic proof plus a standalone finite verification script; no claim of independent validation.
integrity.notation: The paperfolding word starts 11011001 and is the bit complement of the zero-one convention in arXiv:1208.2856.

scientific_limitations: All statements concern zero-based, origin-anchored prefixes of the regular binary paperfolding word with alphabet fixed as {0,1}; arbitrary folding instructions, shifts, circular index, and numbers of absent subsequences are not classified. Historical priority and the proof have not received independent external validation.
title: Exact all-prefix subsequence universality in the regular paperfolding word
